hero.title: THE BIKE CHALLENGE
hero.subtitle:
From weekend bike-overs to cross-country expeditions, we share the routes and stories that inspire your next escape.
No elitism, just adventure.

joinJourney.heading: Join the Journey
joinJourney.body: We believe the best view is seen over a pair of handlebars. The Bike Challenge started as a way to document our own curiosity - filming the climbs, mapping the hidden trails, and finding the best spots to camp. Whether you are prepping for your first overnighter or looking for a new route in Sicily, we’re here to show you it’s all within reach.

blog.heading: Blog
blog.subtitle: The paved road ends, but the story is just beginning. Explore our collection of ride reports, gear guides, and beginner tips from the heart of the gravel community.

articles.title: Island Hopping: Gravel Circles on the Isle of Wight
articles.excerpt: There is something special about catching a ferry to go for a ride. We explored the chalky cliffs and hidden trails of the Isle of Wight to see why this small island is a bucket-list destination for UK gravel riders.

articles.title:
So You Want to Try Bikepacking? 
A Beginner’s Guide
articles.excerpt: Forget the dictionary definitions. Bikepacking is simply about the freedom of exploring further on a bike you love. We break down the basics of gear, planning, and mindset to help you get out on your first backcountry escape.

articles.title: Bikepacking from London to Bruges
articles.excerpt: Proof that you don't need mountains for an epic trip. We swapped gnarly climbs for coastal views and Belgian beer on this perfect beginner-friendly gravel run.

articles.title: Sicily Divide
articles.excerpt: A rugged journey through the heart of the Mediterranean. Discover why the Sicily Divide is a must-ride for anyone seeking dramatic landscapes and world-class food.

articles.title: The Rat Run: Three days of gravel riding and coastal views
articles.excerpt: Last summer, we headed to the counties of Dorset & Wiltshire in the south of England to try out a three-day bikepacking route called “The Rat Run”. If you’re looking for some summery inspiration at the minute, this should be just what you need….

image.alt: The Rat Run Dorset and Wiltshire

articles.title: Bikepacking the Crete Divide
articles.excerpt: Crete might not be the first place that comes to mind when you think of bikepacking destinations, but it has plenty to offer compared with some of the more popular spots.

event.title: Culture Cycling Club Rideout
paragraphs: Spring is in the air, and it’s time to get together for a social spin! Join us on Saturday, April 26th for a morning of coffee, cycling, and community.

We’re starting and finishing at the legendary Forge 1860 / Pearson Shop in London. We’ll kick things off with a coffee and a catch-up before heading out for a relaxed, social loop around Richmond Park. Whether you're a regular or it's your first time joining us, everyone is welcome!

details.label: The Ride
details.value: A friendly, "party pace" loop around Richmond Park.

event.closingNote: Bring your friends, bring your bike, and let’s enjoy the ride together.

form.successMessage: Thanks for RSVPing! We'll see you at Forge 1860.
